episodes.synopsis: High schooler Masahiro Setagawa has been jaded by life and is a helpless delinquent, but everything changes when he meets his teacher, Kosuke Oshiba.
episodes.title: In the Beginning, He Wouldn't Tell Me Anything

episodes.synopsis: Kensuke and Setagawa are having their own respective freak outs about certain people coming back into their lives. What will they do when they can't ignore them?
episodes.title: The Days Go On, But There's More

episodes.synopsis: Kensuke, still reeling from his last encounter, sees a girl dropping Hasekura off at school. Meanwhile, Hasekura thinks of a different way to mend his ties with Kensuke.
episodes.title: Like a Teeny, Tiny Ray of Light

episodes.synopsis: Kensuke has become comfortable with his feelings for Hasekura, and is happy with their relationship. Meanwhile, Setagawa has to confront some truths about his own feelings.
episodes.title: A Hunch, Hidden by Fragrant Smoke

episodes.synopsis: Setagawa can't seem to wrap his head around what happened last time with Kousuke. With his feelings in revolt, Setagawa looks to the past.
episodes.title: A Person Worthy of Love

episodes.synopsis: After meeting up with his old gang, Setagawa decides to become their lap dog again to save Kousuke. Because of this, he starts the distance himself from Ken and the others making everyone worried.
episodes.title: My Savior, Be Free

episodes.synopsis: Setagawa continues his isolation until Kousuke, determined, tries to understand why he's isolating himself from his friends.
episodes.title: The High School Boys Howl

episodes.synopsis: Setagawa finally seems to be accepting his feelings for Kosuke. Kensuke seems more than supportive about his friends' new relationship.
episodes.title: Inextinguishable Emotions Push Me Forward

episodes.synopsis: As Setagawa gets used to his feelings for Kosuke he learns how to balance his needs in a relationship and of his partner's.
episodes.title: Where My Feelings Are Headed

episodes.synopsis: Trouble brews when Setagawa's friend brings up a little detail about his relationship with Kousuke. With anxiety biting at his heels he tries to get reassurance from Kousuke.
episodes.title: Why Is It So Hard To Be Happy?

episodes.synopsis: Kousuke is worried after he is suddenly summoned in to the Principal's office. Has Kousuke and Setagawa's relationship been found out?
episodes.title: That's Why I Just Want You to Smile

episodes.synopsis: Setagawa tries to separate himself from Kousuke but will the separation prove to be too much for them? Will Setagawa finally accept his place in Kousuke's life?
episodes.title: The Kindest Place In The World
